# State Class View (variant): Monitoring and data technician (state)

> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**
>
> Task importance, time share, critical and needed-at-entry values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S): assessment pending (job analysis). They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Target levels are editorial design drafts. A credential gate is shown only when its issuer is verified with a cited source; the other gates are counted, not shown, until the issuer is verified (CR-CP-001 C7).

- **Role:** Monitoring and data technician (`seed:R03-monitoring-data-technician`, P1); authority position (editorial): regulator
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.1.0, rule state-class-view@0.1.0 (proposed), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (agent draft)

- Deploy, maintain and verify field sensor networks — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Manage field sample custody and field quality control — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Assure the quality of environmental data from collection to release — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Engineer environmental sensor-network and streaming data pipelines — journey L2, senior L3
- Collect trace-level and genetic environmental samples without contamination — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Record field observations with protocol fidelity and data integrity — entry L1, journey L2, senior L2
- Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Manage risk in uncontrolled field environments — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Work safely on hazardous, industrial and energized field sites — entry L1, journey L2, senior L2
